biography: Todd "The Flash" Bodine didn't just grow up around racing; he was practically born in the pit lane. His father, a short-track legend in the Carolinas, had Todd turning wrenches before he could read. His first race wasn't in a go-kart, but a beat-up Ford pickup his dad swore "had more heart than horsepower." One sweltering summer night at Myrtle Beach Speedway, with the truck sputtering and spitting, Todd found himself battling wheel-to-wheel with seasoned veterans. He muscled his way to a third-place finish, a moment that solidified his destiny. Bodine clawed his way through the regional circuits, each victory fueled by grit and a healthy dose of showmanship. He caught the eye of Stock USA Gen2, who saw potential in his raw talent and undeniable charisma. Now a veteran, Todd continues to race, a reminder that passion and flair can still ignite the track.
drivingStyle: Bodine's driving style is pure aggression wrapped in a velvet glove. He's known for his late-braking maneuvers, often diving into corners where others fear to tread. Tire management isn't always his strong suit – he prefers to run hard and fast, trusting his instincts to carry him through. When the pressure mounts, Bodine thrives. He's a gambler, willing to take risks that leave spectators breathless and his competitors shaking their heads. He has an uncanny ability to sense when another driver is vulnerable, and he'll exploit that weakness without hesitation.
rivalries: Rick 'The Professor' Eldridge - Eldridge, a meticulous engineer turned driver, represents everything Bodine isn't: calculated, precise, and reserved. Their contrasting styles often lead to clashes on and off the track.

Maria 'Storm' Rodriguez - Rodriguez, a rising star known for her fearless overtakes, challenges Bodine's status as the sport's showman. Their battles are always intense, filled with daring moves and near misses.
Jackson 'The Hammer' Holt - Holt and Bodine have a long history of trading paint. Holt feels Bodine shows off too much and isn't serious enough, while Bodine sees Holt as dull and predictable.
quirks: Always wears the same lucky pair of worn-out cowboy boots to the track, claiming they give him 'extra grip'.
Listens to a specific obscure bluegrass song right before climbing into the car.
Has a habit of winking at the camera after every practice session, regardless of how he performed.
famousQuote: Racing ain't about playing it safe; it's about pushing limits and looking damn good doing it.
careerHighlight: Winning the Stock USA Gen2 Championship in 2018, a culmination of years of hard work and a testament to his unwavering belief in himself.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the Daytona 500 on the final lap in 2015 while leading, a heartbreaking defeat that haunted him for months.
